Commentary.Commentary: So Sri Lanka get a lead of 164 runs. Let's see how the batters respond in their second innings now. They have three overs to negotiate the tricky little period. Zimbabwe would love to take a wicket at least. Stay tuned for Sri Lanka's reply.

The captain Greame Cremer smashed a superb ton and stayed unbeaten on 102. He got a good support by Donald Tiripano as well. That lower order made sure Zimbabwe avoid the follow-on too. For Sri Lanka, Lakmal and Herath finished with three wickets each while Perera took two. The debutant Kumara got one and surprisingly, even Kusal Mendis picked up a wicket.

That's a pretty good fightback by Zimbabwe! They started off strongly yesterday but totally lost the plot today morning. They were 92 for one at one stage but were reduced to 139 for six. The middle order failed as the Lankan bowlers came to the party. There was a solid fightback by the lower order though. First Moor shared a century stand with Cremer but the former failed to reach three figures.

...Day 3, Session 3...

It has been a roller-coaster of a day. First session got completely dominated by the visitors, whereas the home side won the second session. However they still trail by 246 runs and are 47 runs short of avoiding the follow-on. The Zimbabwean camp will be hoping that their captain continue to fight out in the middle. Sri Lanka after having an off session in the match, will look to come back strongly to make amends. Stay tuned for the third and the final session of Day 3.

Peter Moor played an excellent innings and went on to complete his 2nd half century in three innings. He was undone by a short-ball plan of the Lankans and fell on 79 to the debutant, Lahiru Kamara. It was his maiden Test wicket and a crucial one in the context of this game as he was looking dangerous. The skipper carried on from where Moor left and completed his maiden Test fifty. He is still unbeaten on 62 along with Donald Tiripano in the middle.

What a fightback by the Zimbabweans! After being 174 for 6 at Lunch, they went on to pile up runs with a loss of a solo wicket. After Sri Lanka cruised through the Zimbabwe batting line-up in the morning session, it looked as if it would be a simple task for them to clean up the tail. However Peter Moor along with his skipper, Greame Cremer stitched a 132-run partnership for the 7th wicket.

Comedy of errors! Pitched around off, PM gets ahead to defend but the ball comes off the inside half of the bat. The mid-wicket fielder first misfields which leads to an extra run. Then an overthrow from the deep results in one more run. 3 runs added to the total.
50-run stand up between Moor and Cremer!

FOUR! Herath varies it by bowling it slightly side-arm. It lands wide outside off on the fuller side. Moor has settled in and won't miss out on such looseners. He smacks that over covers for a boundary, moves into the 40's.
Served fuller around off, Moor prods forward in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Served around off, defended off the front foot.
Full outside off, driven through the point region for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
NO BALL! The ball slips out of Lakmal's hand as he is about to bowl. It results in a chest high full toss, which Moor guides it through the slip cordon for a boundary.
Full outside off, driven through covers for yet another brace.
Length delivery outside off, taped to point.
This time a couple through the off side. Length delivery on the off stump channel, punched gently off the back foot through covers.
Angling into the pads, Moor flicks it through mid-wicket to pick up a brace.
SURANGA LAKMAL has change of ends.
Wide and full outside off, driven through mid off for a single. Moor will keep the strike.
Sliding into the batsman, defended with the angle on the leg side.
Pitched fuller on the stumps, GC gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it through mid on for a quick single. Good running!
Tossed up around off, Cremer presents a front foot defense.
Served on middle and leg, defended with a straight bat.
Full and wide outside off, driven to covers.
We are back for the afternoon session! Let's see if MOOR and CREMER help Zimbabwe pile up the runs to avoid the follow-on. HERATH to start the proceedings.
...Day 3, Session 2...

Zimbabwe still trail by 363 runs with 4 wickets in hand. It's a huge task ahead of them as they have to score 164 runs more to avoid the follow-on. The cracks have started to widen which is going to favour the visitors. The Lankans would look to take advantage of it and wrap the home side quickly. Let's see how Zimbabwe fight back so join us back in a while to catch the second session.

The spinners then came to party as the skipper worked his magic and scalped the wicket of the dangerous Williams. Dilruwan Perera then picked up a couple of wickets of Ervine and Waller. Peter Moor has looked good out in the middle and has added an unbeaten partnership of 35 with his skipper, Greame Cremer.

A session in Sri Lanka's name. It was always going to be tough for the batsmen in the middle against the quality Lankan spinners. However, it was Suranga Lakmal who sent the two overnight batsmen packing. First his short ball ploy against Mawoyo worked perfectly and broke the 71-run stand. This was the opening of the Zimbabwaen downfall as soon after Masakadza also fell to Lakmal.
Around off, Cremer comes forward and drills it through mid on for a single. That will be LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Fullish around off, defended watchfully off the front foot.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tossed up outside off, turning in, Cremer defends it into the ground.
Fullish outside off, Cremer covers the line this time and defends.
Flighted outside off, Cremer tries to defend but fails to put his bat on the ball.
DILRUWAN PERERA back on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
SIX! What a shot! Tossed up ball outside off, Moor picks the length early and smokes it over long off. It clears the fence and goes all the way for a biggie.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish on off, PJ defends it solidly.
On middle and off, Moor blocks it out off his front foot.
Tossed up outside off, Moor tries to defend but gets an inside edge to the on side.
Good length ball on off, Cremer punches it back to the bowler uppishly. It lands safely though.
In the corridor outside off, Cremer shoulders his arms.
Back of a length ball on off, angling in, Cremer tries to clip but gets a bit of an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length ball on off, Cremer pushes it towards mid off.
Length ball on off, Moor guides it towards third man and takes a single.
Shortish on off, Cremer punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Fullish on middle and off, Moor clears his front leg and lofts it over the mid on region for a boundary.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up around off, Cremer defends it from within his crease.
Landed just outside off, Cremer pushes it towards covers.
Tossed up around off, Cremer covers the line and defends.
Fullish outside off, Cremer drives it towards covers where the fielder does well to stop the ball.
Landed around off, Moor defends it with soft hands.

TWO WIDES! Wayward ball, short and angling down the leg side. Cremer has no chance to play this one and lets it go through. The keeper dives to his left to stop the ball but misses it too. The batsmen take a run as well and the umpire signals a wide.
Length ball around off, Cremer pushes it towards point.
Another short ball on middle and off, Cremer does well to evade it.
Banged in short on off, Cremer ducks under it.
Length delivery, angling away, dabbed back to the bowler.
Banged in short, Cremer ducks to evade it.
LAHIRU KUMARA is back on.
Appeal for an LBW! Tossed up ball around off, Moor tries to defend but gets a bit of an inside edge onto his pads. The umpire turns down the appeal.
Full ball on off, Moor lunges forward and drives it to the cover fielder.
Landed around off, Moor lunges forward and defends.
On middle, Moor gets onto his front foot and defends into the ground.
Full on middle, Cremer drives it through mid on and takes another single.
Full on middle and leg, Moor flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed just outside off, Cremer pushes it to covers.
Landed around the off stump line, Cremer tries to play it awkwardly but gets hit on the body.
Banged in short on middle and leg, Cremer ducks under it.
Fullish outside off, driven to mid on.
FOUR! Fuller length ball outside off, Cremer drives it through the cover region. Beats the fielder there and gets a boundary. Runs are coming off boundaries for Zimbabwe here.
Driven through the cover region for a boundary.
Landed outside off, Moor tries to hit it over the off side but gets an outside edge which falls short of the point fielder. It was in the air for a bit but luckily fell just short of the fielder.
FOUR! Tad short outside off, Moor cuts it through point. The ball races away to the fence for a boundary now. Moor is playing aggressively here.
SIX! Great shot! Around off, Moor picks it early and lofts it hard over long on. The ball goes all the way for a biggie.
Tossed up on off, Moor stays back in his crease and defends.
Landed around off, Moor defends it solidly again.
Tossed up on off, Moor defends it into the ground.
Shortish outside off, Cremer lets it go through.
Short ball on off, Cremer ducks under it.
In the corridor outside off, Cremer leaves it alone.
Fullish outside off, Cremer pushes it to covers.
Shortish on off, Moor tries to push but gets an inside edge to fine leg. Single taken.
Length ball outside off, Moor defends it solidly.
Landed just outside off, Cremer defends it from within his crease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up outside off, Cremer defends it with soft hands.
Outside off, Cremer blocks it out into the ground.
Landed around off, Cremer covers the line and defends.
GREAME CREMER, the skipper is the new man in.

OUT! Zimbabwe are simply falling like nine pins here. Another one bites the dust. Landed around off, turns in a bit after landing, Waller goes onto his back foot to pull it across but misses and gets hit on the pads. Huge appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Perera gets another wicket. Zimbabwe slip further. Replays show the ball would have hit the middle stump.
Short of a length ball on off, Moor stands tall to play this one.
Fuller length ball outside off, Waller drives it through cover-point for three runs.
Banged in short on middle and off, Waller ducks under it.
Landed around off, Waller pushes it to mid on off his front foot.
Length delivery outside off, Waller pushes it towards point.
Good length ball outside off, Waller blocks it out solidly.
SURANGA LAKMAL is back on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up ball around off, Moor defends it with soft hands.
Landed outside off, Moor pushes it through covers for a couple to get off the mark.
PETER MOOR walks in next.

OUT! LBW! Nicely flighted on middle and off, Ervine presses forward and tries to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. Big appeal for a leg before and the umpire raises his finger. Ervine walks back and Zimbabwe have lost half their side now, they still trail by 403 runs.
Tossed up outside off, Ervine pushes it towards covers.
Landed outside off, Ervine shoulders his arms.
Superb delivery! The ball sneaks through the gap between bat and pad and beats the batsman.
Fullish around off, Waller blocks it out solidly.
Good length ball around off, Waller covers the line and defends.
Short ball on middle and leg, Waller ducks under it.
Shortish around off, Waller tries to defend but gets an inside edge to the off side.
Banged in short on middle and leg, Waller lets it go from over him.
Full ball around off, Ervine drives it towards mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Landed just outside off, Waller pushes it towards point.
On the pads, Ervine tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Waller drives it through covers for three runs.
Landed outside off, Waller tries to play but gets an outside edge towards slips.
DILRUWAN PERERA is back on.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side.
Outside off, left alone.
Length delivery on off, angling away, pushed through gap in the covers for a single.
Banged in short, Waller ducks to evade it.
FOUR! Driven through! Once again full and wide outside off, Waller leans into the shot and drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
Angling away from the right-hander, let go by the batsman.
Outside off, Waller gets on the back foot and pushes it through covers for a triple.
Tossed up on middle and leg, defended off the back foot.
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
On middle and off, played into the ground towards short leg.
Sliding into the pads, defended from within the crease.
Served full outside off, spinning in, driven with the spin through mid on for a single.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! That's driven beautifully! Overpitched outside off, that's in Waller's slot and he drives it through the gap in covers for a boundary.
Straying on the pads once again, Ervine flicks it with ease through to deep mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Angling into the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
On the thigh pad, Ervine tucks it away behind square on the leg side for a leg bye.
Short delivery, angling away, Ervine leaves it watchfully.
The batsman guides it to third man. Two runs added to the total.
Landed around off, Waller defends it from within his crease.
MALCOLM WALLER is the new man in.

OUT! Herath gets his man! Tossed up delivery around off, Williams gets down on his knee and goes for the slog sweep. He doesn't time it well at all as the ball goes to the fielder in the deep. Gunaratne at deep square leg makes no mistake and Sri Lanka chip in with another wicket. Captain strikes yet again.
Tossed up around off, Williams defends it from within his crease.
Landed outside off, Williams punches it through covers for a couple.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full outside off, Williams gets into the position and reverse sweeps it to third man for a boundary.
Landed outside off, yet another left alone.
In the corridor outside off, Ervine is not interested in playing that.
Way outside off, another left alone.
Back of a length ball around off, Ervine shoulders his arms.
Short and wide outside off, Ervine lets it go through.
Short and wide outside off, Williams slashes it through backward point for a single.
LAHIRU KUMARA comes on to bowl.
Served fuller on the stumps, defended watchfully.
Overpitched delivery, this time Williams sweeps and collects a single through the square leg.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Ervine sweeps the full delivery once again and picks up a single this time.
FOUR! Swept away! Served full around off, CE kneels down and sweeps through square leg for a boundary.

CHANCE! Tossed up outside off, spinning in, Ervine prods forward in defense but misjudges the spin on it and catches the outside edge oh his bat and hits Kusal Perera's pads. Good piece of bowling by the skipper.
Short delivery angling in, Ervine gets on his toes and glances through fine leg for a single.

Back of a length delivery, Ervine looks to duck at first but the ball keeps low and Ervine gets up at the last moment. Kusal Perera behind the wicket gets an awkward bounce in front of him and gets hit on the toes.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Angling into the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Lakmal changes the angle, comes from around the wicket, angles into the southpaw, defended off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Served on off, spinning in, defended watchfully.
Pitched up delivery on the stumps, Ervine sweeps it on the leg side for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Spinning into the pads, driven through mid on for a single.
Peach of a delivery! Tossed up outside off, luring Williams forward. He obliges and prods forward in defense, playing for the turn. However, it's a straighter one by Herath wand beats the batsman.
Angling away from the southpaw, let go by Ervine.
Length delivery, tapped through mid off with soft hands for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, moving away, left alone.

OUT! Lakmal strikes once again! Both the overnight batsmen depart! Lakmal bowls it full in the channel of uncertainty. Masakadza goes for an expansive drive, away from his body and pays the price. The away movement of the ball catches the outside edge of his bat and goes straight in the hands of Karunaratne at first slip. That was a poor choice of shot by Masakdza, who had settled in the middle. Sean Williams will walk in at number 5.
Length delivery outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Served fuller around middle and off, defended from within the crease.
Spinning into the pads, CE goes onto his back foot and plays it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up around off, Ervine defends it carefully.

Straying on the pads, defended on the leg side.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
CRAIG ERVINE is the next man in.

OUT! Short ball does the trick! Mawoyo has to walk back! Lakmal who is testing Mawoyo with the short ball bowls third short delivery of the over. This time closer to the body of the batsman. Mawoyo can't resist himself from playing it and pulls unconvincingly. Herath has cleverly placed a fielder between the inner circle line and the boundary in the square leg region. Gunaratne present there, doesn't even have to move a touch and takes it safely with a reverse cup. Lakmal finally gets the much needed breakthrough for the Lankans.
Outside off, left alone.
Short delivery once again, this time closer to his body. Mawoyo again leaves it.
Short and wide outside off, an easy leave for the batsman.

Great delivery! Pitched slightly fuller on the off stump line, Mawoyo looks to play with the angle but the movement off the seam makes the ball move slightly away, catches the outside part of his bat and runs towards covers.
Sliding into the batsman, Masakadza gets on the back foot to defend it.
Straighter one outside off, HM makes a watchful leave.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Served outside off, Masakadza kneels down to sweep but fails to connect it.
Pitched up delivery, TM gets behind the line of the delivery and defends.
Outside off, pushed towards covers.
Shortish delivery wide outside off, guided through the slip cordon for a brace.
Again on a channel outside off, defended watchfully.
Back of a length delivery on off, Mawoyo hops and defends it into the ground.
Pitched on a length outside off, defended with a straight bat.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Served full on the off stump channel, TM looks to defend but gets off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, spinning away slightly, Mawoyo looks to defend but catches the outside part of the bat into the ground.
Pitched around off, prodded forward in defence.
Served full on middle and leg, Mawoyo presents a front foot defense.
Tossed up around off, defended by proding forward.
Spin from the other end. Rangana Herath to bowl.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Wide down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone.
First runs of the day! Angling into the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Just outside off on a good length, Mawoyo makes a watchful leave.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The players are out in the middle. Masakadza and Mawoyo will continue to bat and look to extend their partnership. Lakmal to start the proceedings of the day with the ball.

Pat Symcox says that pitch is going to break up and make it difficult to bat on. Reckons Herath is going to be a real threat. The cracks on the pitch are going to create confusion in batsman's mind on whether which ball will turn and which won't. Ends up by saying once again that it is going to be a tough batting day.

Hello everyone to the coverage of day 3 of the first Test between Zimbabwe and Sri Lanka in Harare. Sri Lanka piled up 537 yesterday and then were able to pick a wicket as well. Since then, the hosts batted well as Mawoyo and Masakadza have shared a 67-run stand so far. They still need 250 more runs to avoid the follow-on though and first they will be looking to cross that line. Should be another interesting day of Test cricket.
...Day 3, Session 1...

The pitch has started to misbehave. The cracks have started to open up and the balls are keeping low a bit too often. Batting is going to get difficult and Zimbabwe will have their hands full tomorrow. Their aim would be to take it session by session and try and not throw their wickets away. Join us at 1330 IST (0800 GMT) for all the action from Day 3. Until then, Adios! Take Care!

The Sri Lankans would not be too perturbed with the score right now. They posted a big total riding on the tons from Kusal Perera and Upul Tharanga and have plenty to play with. The seamers were not that effective but had Karunaratne taken the catch off Masakadza, it might have been a better story. Herath struck in his first over while Dilruwan was not bad either.

An excellent reply from Zimbabwe after conceding 537. They lost Chari early but this 67-run stand between Mawoyo and Masakadza at nearly 4 an over would have instilled some confidence in the dressing room. The hosts have a long way to go, needing 250 to avoid the follow-on itself, but at least, it is a good start.
Full and outside off, driven on the up to short extra cover. STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Shortish ball, punched back to the bowler.
FOUR! Nicely done! Full and outside off, Masakadza gets down and sweeps it wide of the man running from backward square leg to his left for a boundary! Moves to 33. The deficit is now 449.
Beautiful bowling. Flighted outside off, HM comes forward to defend but the ball goes straight on and beats the outside edge. Ooohhs and aahhs from the close-in fielders.
The arm ball now, keeps low, Hamilton goes back and punches it towards the bowler.
Landed outside off, Masakadza stays back to defend.
Last over of the day then...
Tossed up outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Full again, pushed towards cover.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Still looping it up on off, Hamilton comes forward to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Amazing! Thrown up wide outside off, Masakadza comes forward and drives this through the covers for a boundary! The stand moves to 62 from 94 balls now.
Slowly looped up outside off, Masakadza comes forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Landed outside off, TM is squared up and gets an outside edge to the off side.
Shortish in length, Tino gets back and works it towards short mid-wicket.
Landed outside off, Mawoyo looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge to the bowler.
Full again, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Hamilton gets down and sweeps it through square leg for a single. 259 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
Landed outside off, Masakadza stays back to defend but the ball keeps low and goes off the bottom edge to the leg side.
Full and outside off, well kept out.
Full and outside off, driven past a diving short extra cover towards widish long off for a run.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
GOES PAST SHORT LEG NOW! The arm ball, on middle, Tino looks to flick but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat wide of short leg and the batsmen take a single.
IN THE AIR... JUST SHORT! Anxious moments. Full and outside off, Mawoyo comes forward to flick but hits this uppishly. It almost carries to the man at short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, defended watchfully.
Landed outside off, Mawoyo comes forward and defends it to the off side.
Full and outside off, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid on again.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid on.
Is squared up on this one, as the ball pitches on off and straightens a touch, takes the leading edge and goes to the off side.
Pushes this towards point, sets off for what should have been an easy single but Masakadza sends him back.
Similar ball, same shot, same result.
A bit of more loop outside off, pushed towards short extra cover.
Landed around off, watchfully defended.
Fuller on middle and off, Tino comes forward and flicks it past short leg for a single.
The arm ball on middle and off, defended to the leg side.
Tossed up outside off, Mawoyo comes forward and defends.
Full on middle and off, pushed back to the bowler.
This is slower through the air, Hamilton comes forward and defends it to the off side.
Landed outside off, the arm ball, Masakadza gets across and lets it go.
Works this through mid-wicket for a single.
Comes down the track and pushes it towards mid on but Dilruwan dives to his right to stop the ball.
Outside off, Mawoyo stays back to push it towards first slip.
DILRUWAN PERERA comes on to bowl now.
Comes forward and defends.
Goes back and punches it away.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
50-run stand is up in just 59 balls!
FOUR! Brutal! Looped up outside off, Masakadza gets his left leg out of the way and clobbers this past mid on for a boundary! Moves to 22 from 24 balls!
Outside off, pushed towards cover.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.

FOUR! A poor ball to finish the over. Full on middle and off, Mawoyo flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a boundary! 15 from the over, 25 off the last 2! Kumara has gone for 34 in his 4 overs so far. 269 more needed to avoid the follow-on.

Brilliant shot. On a good length outside off, HM punches it on the up between cover and mid off. Suranga Lakmal gives it a good chase from mid off and gets to the ball, slides and pulls it back in, himself tumbling beyond the ropes. Three runs taken.
Full and outside off, perhaps a slower ball, Hamilton lets it go and the ball bounces on its way to the keeper.
On a good length outside off, angled in, defended watchfully.

FOUR! Excellent shot. Full and wide outside off, Masakadza gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it through the covers now for boundaries in succession! 276 more needed to avoid the follow-on. The stand moves to 41 from 52 balls.
FOUR! A short ball, angled in from outside off, whipped to the mid-wicket fence. The deficit is now 479. Masakadza moves to 11.
On middle and leg, Tino looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. 10 from the over.
FOUR BYES! Full and wide outside off, Mawoyo goes hard with the cover drive and is beaten as the ball stays low. It beats the keeper as well and goes through his legs to the fence behind.
FOUR! What a shot. Landed outside off, Mawowo goes back and cuts it past first slip to third man! 50 UP FOR ZIMBABWE! 288 more needed to avoid the follow-on. Mawoyo moves to 33.

JUST OUT OF REACH! Mawoyo is leading a charmed life out there. Full and outside off, Tino swings hard and gets it from the inner half of the bat. The ball just elides a leaping mid-wicket fielder. The mid on fielder gets to the ball and returns the ball to Herath as the batsmen jog back for the second. DIRECT HIT would have had Masakadza.
Around off, defended towards silly point.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to short extra cover.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Goes back and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Not totally convincing. A short ball around middle, Mawoyo looks to hook but miscues it. However, it goes very fine of the man at fine leg and crosses the ropes. The stand moves to 22.
On a good length outside off, Tino comes forward and pushes it towards point again.
On a good length outside off, angling in, defended from the crease towards short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Mawoyo pushes forward and gets the ball towards point.
LAHIRU KUMARA gets another go after a wayward opening spell.

DRINKS BREAK. A decent hour for the Zimbabweans. They have lost only Chari and negotiated Herath pretty much effectively. But they have a long way to go. 11 overs left in the day. Can the pair of Mawoyo and Masakadza see them till the close?
Short and outside off, punched towards mid off.
Well played. Full on middle and leg, Mawoyo gets down and plays a controlled sweep towards backward square leg for a single. 299 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
Generously tossed up outside off, TM looks to go hard at that but mistimes it to mid off.
Full and outside off, well kept out.
This is tossed up on off, Tino comes forward and whips it straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Mawoyo comes forward and defends it in front of silly point.
FOUR! Bosh! What a shot. A half tracker on middle and off, Masakadza swivels and pulls it through square leg for a boundary! The deficit is now 499.
A short ball on middle, bounces awkwardly but Tino helps it nicely through backward square leg for one.
Full and around off, pushed straight to short mid-wicket.
Nicely done. Pushes this with soft hands through the covers and takes a quick run.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single. Masakadaza wants the second but is sent back. Mawoyo moves to 20.
On a good length outside off, pushed away from his body to point.
Quicker from Herath, TM goes back and tucks it through backward square leg for a single. The stand moves to 10.

FOUR! Risky shot. This is full and straight, Mawoyo goes for an ambitious sweeps shot and gets an under edge which goes to the fine leg fence. Had he missed, he would have been dismissed. 308 more needed to avoid the follow-on.

Huge appeal for LBW! Turned down! Full on middle, angling down, Tino thrusts forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Perhaps that was going down the leg side. Hawk Eye shows it to be clipping leg stump. Lucky chap, is Mawoyo.
Full and outside off, nicely paddled through backward square leg for a couple.
Landed outside off, Mawoyo stretches forward to defend.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Driven towards the mid off region.
Full and outside off, played straight to point.
Similar ball, full and slightly wider outside off, HM keeps it out.
Full and outside off again, well defended.
Full and outside off, watchfully pushed out.
This is the arm ball now, on middle, Hamilton pushes forward and gets a thick inside edge wide of short leg.
Varies his pace, loops this outside off, Masakadza comes forward and blocks.
Landed outside off, darting in, punched towards point.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Goes back in his crease and blocks.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.

EDGED, DROPPED! A simple chance. Full and wide outside off, swinging away, Masakadza goes for the full-blooded cover drive and knicks it behind. The ball goes straight to Dimuth Karunaratne at first slip who fluffs it. The batsmen take a single. Lakmal is not impressed.
Outside off, Masakadza plays it at the last moment and gets an under edge.
Full and outside off, stays low, pushed to the off side.
Full and outside off, well defended. 3 runs and a wicket from the skipper's first over.

That is lucky. Looped up outside off, Masakadza goes for the big booming cover drive but is beaten by the slowness of the ball. He is early into his stroke and gets a thick inside edge which goes to the leg side.
HAMILTON MASAKADZA walks in at number 3, replacing Chari.

OUT! LBW! Herath strikes in his first over! The arm ball, skidding from outside off, catches Chari back in his crease and goes past his defense to hit the back pad. Looked to be angling down the leg side but the umpire raises his finger. Hawk Eye shows it to be clipping leg stump. Fair call then.
Full and outside off, Mawoyo looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge which goes past short leg. A run taken.

Full and outside off, Chari gets down to play the sweep but misses. The ball goes off something wide of first slip, who turns to his left, anticipating a paddle and has to turn back. The batsmen take a single. The umpire reckons that was a top edge. Replays show the ball going off the arm.
Full and outside off, left alone.
RANGANA HERATH comes into the attack early.
Full and well outside off, well left alone.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
FOUR! Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a boundary!
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
A high full toss, on middle, Mawoyo looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground. A committed effort by the fielder to save runs for his team.
EDGED, FOUR! Full and outside off, Mawoyo pushes inside the line and gets a thick outside edge which flies past second slip to third man!
Down the leg side, Mawoyo takes his glove out of the way.
Full and wide outside off, not played at.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover. Chari sets off for a single but is sent back.
Outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Landed outside off, pushed in front of cover for a quick single. For some reason, the fielder did not throw.
Full and outside off, left alone.

Huge LBW appeal, but turned down. Overoptimistic. Comes in from wide of the crease and angles this into the right-hander and strikes him, perhaps in front of leg stump. The angle would have taken the ball down the leg side, as confirmed by Hawk Eye. An ordinary start for the debutant.
FOUR! Chari is away! A short ball outside off, Chari places this through point and gets a boundary! 329 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Comes in with the angle from outside off, Brian misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Full and down the leg side again, flick shot missed, this time Perera collects.
Much better from Kumara, angles this into the right hander, Chari defends it watchfully.

FIVE WIDES! Whoopps.... that is a nervous start. Down the leg side, swings a mile further, Chari lets it go and poor Kusal Perera has no chance of stopping it even with a full length dive to his left.
Debutant LAHIRU KUMARA to bowl from the other end.
Angled away from outside off, not played at.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and wide outside off, not played at.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Outside off, left alone.
On a good length outside off, Mawoyo pushes inside the line but the ball swings away and beats him.
